headline: Mexico Third-Quarter GDP Growth Accelerates to 3.3% Year-on-Year
summary: Mexico's gross domestic product expanded 3.3% year-on-year in the third quarter of 2026, marking its fastest pace of growth in three years and up from 2.2% in the second quarter.
why: Mexico is Latin America's second-largest economy, heavily integrated with North American manufacturing supply chains.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Stronger GDP performance signals resilient economic activity across manufacturing and service sectors.
